caption: The drawing depicts a large, rounded lidded jar with a wide, bulbous body and a short, narrow base. The jar is rendered in a brownish-red color with darker brown and black streaks and blotches across the surface. It features two small, rounded handles on either side just below the jar's shoulder area. The lid has a knob-like handle at the top and also displays the same coloration as the main body of the jar. The entire jar and lid are outlined with fine, dark lines that emphasize their form. In the top right corner of the drawing, there is a smaller, simple line sketch of the same jar with its lid, positioned within a faint square border. The background is a plain, off-white or cream color, with a single rectangular border enclosing the main image and the inset sketch.
title: Jar with Cover
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
